UpdateAutomaticStorageExpansionConfigura.action: Valid values: - open, enable automatic storage expansion - stop, disable automatic storage expansion - update, modify the free space threshold or disk upper limit while automatic storage expansion is enabled
UpdateAutomaticStorageExpansionConfigura.freeSpaceThreshold: Free space threshold, in %. Required when action is open. Can only be modified while automatic storage expansion is enabled for the instance
UpdateAutomaticStorageExpansionConfigura.diskMaxLimit: Upper limit of the auto-expanded disk, in GB. Required when action is open. Can only be modified while automatic storage expansion is enabled for the instance. Validation: must be a multiple of 5, must be greater than the instance's current disk quota, and must be less than or equal to the disk upper limit allowed when the instance is reconfigured
